changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Restore IS_BEST_IND='Y' on VID 1 when a strategy has no current best
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BT.STRATEGY s SET IS_BEST_IND = 'Y' WHERE s.STRATEGY_VID = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BT.STRATEGY x WHERE x.STRATEGY_ID = s.STRATEGY_ID AND x.IS_BEST_IND = 'Y' );
